parental_testing_statement.value: NGS analysis was performed first on Pt1 and her parents (trio-based WES); the variant was identified in Pt1 and her mother (Pt 4).

functional_evidence_statement.value: Western blot: strongly reduced A20 expression in PBMCs of all patients (Pt1-4) compared to healthy donors; patients' PBMCs expressed markedly higher IL-1β, IL-6 and TNF-α mRNA after LPS and released markedly higher IL-1β, IL-6 and TNF-α; markedly higher circulating CXCL9 and CXCL10 in all patients; markedly high total STAT1 in unstimulated monocytes of all four patients; pSTAT1-positive monocytes after IFNγ markedly increased in 3 out of 4 patients; higher CXCL9/CXCL10 mRNA in PBMCs. Authors: 'Functional analyses confirmed the pathogenicity of the mutation.' Higher p65 NF-kB (S536) phosphorylation in unstimulated and LPS-stimulated PBMCs from Pt1 and Pt4 compared to healthy donors.

pathogenicity_as_stated_by_authors.value: pathogenic ("a novel pathogenic mutation"; predicted to be damaging by in silico tools)
